_comment: Per-era style blocks for Drift Wood / ROFLCOPTER panels. comic_tool.py composes each panel's image prompt as prefix + panel prompt + suffix, and the negative as era negative + panel negative. Lettering (balloons, captions, the margin signature and mark) is NEVER generated — it is composited by comic_studio.html / the print layout. Prompts describe qualities, not living artists; the brief's named references live in lore/drift_wood/the_strip.md.

era1.name: The High School Zine Era
era1.line: scratchy crow-quill and ballpoint on cardstock, photocopied with harsh contrast; jagged line weights; heavy black spotting; cluttered balloons
era1.paper: cardstock, xeroxed; from 1999 the college paper's newsprint; from 2000 the laundromat digest (quarter-letter)
era1.palette: pure black and white; no grays; xerox grain
era1.prompt_prefix: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones,
era1.prompt_suffix: , no text, no lettering, no speech balloons, no signature
era1.negative: color, gray gradients, photorealistic, 3D render, smooth digital line, text, letters, watermark, signature, extra fingers

era2.name: The Webcomic Diaspora
era2.line: digitized brush-pen on bristol; rubbery, kinetic; blog-era minimalism; muddy early-digital flats
era2.paper: bristol scanned; the browser; from 2008 coastal weekly newsprint a week behind
era2.palette: limited muddy digital flats over black brush line; Sundays begin in watercolor, over-wet at first
era2.prompt_prefix: comic strip panel, black brush-pen ink line with muddy early-2000s digital flat colors, rubbery kinetic linework, mid-2000s webcomic look, limited palette, slightly misregistered fills,
era2.prompt_suffix: , no text, no lettering, no speech balloons, no signature
era2.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, painterly, glossy, text, letters, watermark, signature, extra fingers

era3.name: The Masterwork of Mediocrity
era3.line: razor-sharp, ultra-confident brush and ink; pristine architectural perspective; crisp silhouette; expressive character geometry; zero crosshatch in close-ups
era3.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays
era3.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet watercolor — gray-green moss, coastal fog, rusted galvanized tin, bruised dusk. Arc 4: raw umber, Payne's gray, Prussian blue, raw sienna, one accent of Naples yellow
era3.prompt_prefix: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space,
era3.prompt_suffix: , no text, no lettering, no speech balloons, no signature
era3.prompt_prefix_sunday: comic Sunday page tier, confident brush-and-ink line over wet-on-wet watercolor washes on cold-press paper, Pacific Northwest coastal light, gray-green moss, fog, rusted galvanized tin, water bleeding softly over the ink edge,
era3.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, text, letters, watermark, signature, extra fingers

era4.name: The Pacific Twilight · ROFLCOPTER
era4.line: spare, knowing, deeply human; economy of line; often no panel borders
era4.paper: whatever was in the garage: Arches, bristol, the backs of motel registration cards
era4.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
era4.prompt_prefix: comic page, spare knowing ink line with soft watercolor in muted ochre, slate blue and misty sea-foam green, Pacific Northwest coastal light, economy of line, quiet composition,
era4.prompt_suffix: , no text, no lettering, no speech balloons, no signature
era4.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, saturated color, neon, anime, busy composition, text, letters, watermark, signature, extra fingers

digest_cover.print: 1 per page (2 per page in Vol. I)

special.layout: full page, tiers or a single image

marks.gull: a tiny stylized gull, two strokes
marks.crab: a tiny stylized crab, seen from above
marks.gull_dog: the gull with a small dog silhouette beside it (1999 once; 'Lanes' 2009 once)
marks.flat_stroke: a single clean unbroken horizontal stroke (Nov 30, 2014)
marks.scruff: a tiny three-legged scruff of ink, asleep (Dec 21, 2014 onward)
marks.gull_scruff: the gull and the scruff both (Dec 27, 2020)
marks.roflcopter: the word ROFLCOPTER, tiny, in the margin (2021 onward)
marks.finch: Arthur Finch, 1997-2027, with a cedar branch floating out (the final page)
